content_voiceover: This is the diagnostic framework for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, based on the revised Histiocyte Society HLH 2004 study and reflected in the T P O G HLH 2025 protocol. You can establish the diagnosis if any one of three pathways is fulfilled. Pathway A is a molecular diagnosis consistent with familial HLH in a patient with suggestive signs and symptoms, meaning a pathogenic biallelic mutation in one of the known genes: P R F one, U N C thirteen D, S T X eleven, S T X B P two, L Y S T, R A B twenty seven A, S H two D one A, X I A P, or N L R C four. Pathway B is functional cellular findings consistent with familial HLH. And pathway C, the one tested most often, requires five out of seven clinical and laboratory criteria. Those seven are: fever of thirty eight point five Celsius or higher; splenomegaly at least two centimeters below the costal margin; cytopenia affecting at least two of three lineages, meaning hemoglobin under nine, platelets under one hundred thousand, or neutrophils under one thousand; hypertriglyceridemia at or above three millimoles per liter, or hypofibrinogenemia at or below one hundred fifty milligrams per deciliter; hemophagocytosis seen on bone marrow, spleen, or lymph node biopsy without evidence of malignancy; hyperferritinemia at or above five hundred micrograms per liter; and soluble C D twenty five, the soluble interleukin two receptor, at or above twenty four hundred units per milliliter. Memorizing this five of seven list cold is essential for boards.
keypoints: HLH diagnosis: molecular diagnosis (A), functional findings (B), or 5 of 7 clinical criteria (C)
5 of 7 criteria: fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia or hypofibrinogenemia, hemophagocytosis, hyperferritinemia, elevated soluble CD25
Genetic HLH genes include PRF1, UNC13D, STX11, STXBP2, RAB27A, LYST, SH2D1A, XIAP, NLRC4
This is the HLH-2004 criteria set, still the backbone of current TPOG protocols
keypoint_voiceover: HLH can be diagnosed by a molecular diagnosis, by functional cellular findings, or by meeting five of seven clinical and lab criteria. Those seven are fever, splenomegaly, cytopenia in two or more lineages, hypertriglyceridemia or low fibrinogen, hemophagocytosis on biopsy, high ferritin, and elevated soluble C D twenty five. Know this five of seven list cold for boards.
